summary: Compared the product-inquiry product-tabs reference, rendered crop, diff, and retained geometry. Outer tab bounds are within 1 px, but the underlying selected tab/content and inquiry dialog composition are wrong; mismatch is 19.133%.
issues: VIS-PRODUCT-INQUIRY-TABS-001 (critical) — property: underlying state; expected: 'Opis produktu' active with long product-description content behind the inquiry dialog; actual: 'Dane techniczne' is active and the technical table is shown; fix: preserve the source state family when opening the inquiry overlay and render the correct active tab/content.

VIS-PRODUCT-INQUIRY-TABS-002 (critical) — property: inquiry dialog contents/position; expected: centered bordered dialog showing textarea bottom, explanatory copy, privacy copy, and button over the middle of the component; actual: a large unbordered white block begins higher, obscures different areas, and only the button is visible in the retained crop; fix: match the source dialog bounds, border/radius, vertical offset, and complete native editable form content without submitting it.

VIS-PRODUCT-INQUIRY-TABS-003 (high) — property: tab navigation geometry; expected: active second tab width about 224 px with source five-column spacing; actual: active first tab is about 288 px and labels are redistributed; fix: match the source tab grid and active-tab state.

VIS-PRODUCT-INQUIRY-TABS-004 (medium) — property: typography; expected: source text metrics in tabs, product copy, and dialog; actual: smaller/heavier glyphs and different wrapping throughout; fix: apply the exact source font weights, sizes, and line-heights.
